purpose: Overlay Wave 7 intervention, cycle-resolved cleaning, predictive-maintenance and hot-runner actual-state observability evidence onto the Book coverage map without claiming that the remaining raw-data gaps are closed.

overlays.newEditorialCapability: Teach two quantified black-defect before/intervention/after cases plus a genuinely cycle-resolved hot-runner cleaning trajectory as an explicitly labelled analogue for how recovery evidence should be read.
overlays.boundary: The color-changeover study is not black-speck evidence, and neither black-defect case exposes a rights-clear shot-by-shot onset -> intervention -> recovery trace; the chapter therefore remains a targeted raw-data gap.

overlays.newEditorialCapability: Separate hot-runner command from measured pin movement/position, motor current or force, local cavity pressure, cycle-resolved cleaning response and eventual part-quality evidence.
overlays.boundary: The public sources still do not provide one synchronized raw dataset containing actual pin position, motor current/torque, cavity pressure and cavity-specific quality.

overlays.newEditorialCapability: Connect cycle-by-cycle visual quality, in-mould sensing, actuator actual-state signals and longer-horizon mould reliability into one monitoring hierarchy.
Use real cases to teach measurement-system checking, competing hypotheses, statistical testing, intervention and post-change verification rather than jumping directly from symptom to cause.
Extend Wave 6 lifecycle degradation evidence into condition-based maintenance decision logic while keeping modeled savings distinct from physical wear measurements.
